name: Chimp Lab PVP
summary: Chimp Lab PVP is an intense VR multiplayer game that revolves around fast-paced player-versus-player combat using gorilla locomotion, inspired by Another Axiom’s movement system. Players must master skillful climbing, jumping, and wall-running to outmaneuver opponents in dynamic arenas. With no buttons for movement, every action relies on physical arm motions, making battles feel immersive and skill-based.
